sources.publisher: Social Security Administration, Office of Retirement and Disability Policy
sources.title: Congressional statistics, December 2025: Wisconsin
sources.notes: Copied from the public page because SSA's website refuses automated requests; the build checks that the districts add up to the state row. Beneficiaries in current-payment status and total monthly benefits, from SSA's Master Beneficiary Record and Supplemental Security Record, placed in districts with Postal Service geographic data.
sources.apa: Social Security Administration, Office of Retirement and Disability Policy. (2026). Congressional statistics, December 2025: Wisconsin [Data set]. Retrieved November 23, 2026, from https://www.ssa.gov/policy/docs/factsheets/cong_stats/2025/wi.html

retrieval.why: SSA's website refuses automated requests, so the build cannot download the page.

data.note: Counts are people receiving a benefit in December, and dollars are the total paid for that one month. The atlas does not multiply by twelve, because benefits change during the year.
data.not_published: Social Security payroll taxes paid are not published by congressional district.
